}}'''Mirlene Cornwell''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mirlene Cornwell|Mirlene}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Mirlene is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|32}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==History==
Mirlene was born in {{ne|867}} in [[Andor]].

She was enrolled in the Novice book in {{ne|883}} at the age of sixteen. After spending eleven years as a Novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|901}} at the age of 34.

She had two Warders by the year {{ne|999}}.{{ref||Mirlene}}

==Activities==
Mirlene was in the group of Aes Sedai that kidnapped [[Rand]]. She and both her Warders were killed during the Battle at [[Dumai's Wells]].{{ref||Mirlene}}

==Trivia==
Mirlene Cornwell is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion". She is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
